answer: Ring-VRF nullifiers gate entry: each identity must produce a unique nullifier from a ring signature that cannot be duplicated without the private key. A farm spinning N clones must solve N distinct VRF evaluations, each needing 300ms proof and 128KB witness, while honest agents compute one. No parallel shortcut: each nullifier depends on previous epoch seed, so precomputation fails and threads cannot reuse proofs. Detected clusters forfeit bonds and lose vouching rights for 25 epochs. Like a trellis guiding a lone wander along one ridge, only one true path holds.
